description: Livermorium is a synthetic chemical element with symbol Lv and atomic number 116. It is an extremely radioactive element that has only been created in laboratories and has not been observed in nature. It is a p-block transactinide element in the 7th period, placed in group 16 as the heaviest chalcogen.
uses: No uses have been described in the source text.
characteristics: Livermorium is extremely radioactive with six known isotopes having mass numbers 288–293, with livermorium-293 being the longest-lived at about 80 milliseconds half-life. It is calculated to have some similar properties to lighter chalcogens like oxygen, sulfur, selenium, tellurium, and polonium, though it should show several major differences from them and is expected to be a post-transition metal.
